main_text.l: VNITARVM
IVLIAE, CLIVIAE,
MONTIVM, Provinciarum.
MEMBRVM QVARTVM
De Provincia Montana, ejusque Comitibus se-
decim, Ducibus septem, Sectionibus duabus
explicatus.
PROVINCIA MONTANA, ut eam ante omnia primum
describamus, partim à Montibus omnibus, quorum in
ejus districtu ingens copia, partim à Septem illis Burgis,
vulgo Siebenburghe, ex quibus quatuor tantum, sicut
etiam eorundem rupibus seu cautibus, castra ceu ἀκροπόλεις Wind-
eccianum, Leoburgicum, quæ Montanæ ditionis sunt, Drachen-
felsium Milendonciorum, item & VVolckenburgium, sic dictum,
quod altitudine sua nubes pulsent supra Bonam à Friderico Saer-
werdano Episcopo Colon. structum, sed hodie destructum; Reliquis
tribus Burgis inhabitatis, atque incultis, inædificata sunt, no-
menclaturam fortitur. Septem autem Burgi à Sigena usque & traëtu
Nassovio deducti ab orientali Rheni parte Coloniensem dio-
cœsin & urbem adspiciunt. De quibus Bernhardus Mollerus in
descriptione Rheni:

l.i: Sunt procul à dextro septeni limite Montes,
Altius in quorum vertice castra sedent.
Pars homini colitur, medium descivit ab usu,
Pars hominem nescit, monstra fovere solet.
Hic lemurum formæ vulgus terrore fatigant,
Dum locat insolito, territus hoste fugit.
Euro notho septem spectare Colonia monteis,
Quin etiam longè castra videre potest.
Quatuor exsurgunt, nondum quæ fustulit ætas
apô. Salva Draconina restant fastigia rupis,
Nubis adhuc restant castra, manere vides.

page.notes: The top of the page shows faint show-through of the reverse page and was not transcribed. Several Greek and Hebrew-like fragments in the verses are doubtful: "apô" in the line "monte venustat apô" is probably a printed ornament or damaged word and may be wrong. The Greek word "ἀκροπόλεις" after "ceu" is copied as read and should be checked. Small roman numerals in the right margin beside the verses (II, III, IIII) are faint and were not transcribed.
